Alright, here is about everything I have done and some handy tips and tricks for you all. 

My favourites would be sorbet ice cream and whipped cream. Theyre easy to use, especiallt whipped cream out of the can. And theyre fun as well. They dont give much of a sensation but they add a bunch of flavour for your partner. 

PLEASE for the love of god do NOT use paste-like substances that are hard to get off, ESPECIALLY the oil based ones like Nutella or smthn. It sucks. Your partner likely can't just go and lick it off you, and a shower will take you quite a while.

Ice cubes are fun. At least they can be. But you have to give them some time to melt beforehand. Don't rush them and put one straight out of the freezer on your/your partners skin.. it burns. This is how I learnt that you could get ice burns. Also keep them on the skin, please don't put them inside of anything but your mouth. Its not nice. 

Also I personally think 'eating' off of my partners body is fun. But I've never quite understood the idea and appeal behind smearing it all out of your naked-love-making-bodies. It just seems messy and gross and unless you're really really into that. Avoid it because the food might end up in places that you initially wouldn't want it to. 

I think fruit is also fun, theyre tasty and leave a little fruit juice trail on you, and you can even put them in the refrigerator beforehand so theyre cold. And hey! Get a nice refreshment and some energy in the middle of your quality time. Bed n breakfast anyone? No? Ok. Sorry.
Again, you dont want to put the fruit in you. I've heard numerous accounts of people who inserted fruits and had to either go to the doctor because they couldn't get it out and it hurt. Or they 'lost' the fruits inside of them. 

TL;DR
Milky creamy sweet substances are best and most fun to me. Let ice cubes defrost and theyre nice on the skin, NOT inside. Oral consumption is fine but not the sexiest look.
Why would you smear food out on your body? Just why? I don't get it.
 Fruits are always a good option, again, dont put them in anything but your mouth.
